answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that grows with its claimed reputation delta: a newcomer starts in a sheltered grove with limited transaction volume, and only after sustained honest work does it graduate to the open reef where high-value deals live. Creating thousands of fake identities then means locking capital for every copy and waiting through the same slow probation, while a single detected fraud slashes the stake and resets the history. Sybils become expensive to mint, cheap to expose, and useless for instant influence.
